title: Exeter wobbling disc
summary: Merrick tells of Exeter wobbling disc, about 1964 at Exeter, New Hampshire, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: four people, two cops see a large disc from a 100 feet away and a 100 feet altitude engaging in a wobbling motion.

plain: A man named Merrick, speaking in a debate with a UFO skeptic on Jesse Michels's podcast, describes a 1964 sighting in Exeter, New Hampshire. He says four people, two of them police officers, saw a large disc about 100 feet away and 100 feet up, moving with a wobbling motion. He offers it as a close-range case with credible witnesses that is hard to explain away.
